capabilities: Define per-day prompts with file types (text, note, checkbox, slider)
Answer prompts in a dialog and insert them into the daily note
Create the daily note automatically if it does not exist
Customize the prompts section heading and line prefix
problem: Obsidian daily notes start empty, so recurring self-reflection questions must be retyped or pasted each day.
summary: Journaling helper that defines daily prompts (text, note, checkbox, slider) and fills answers into the daily note.
